name: QrCode
purpose: Encode text locally into a named SVG QR graphic with controlled state and explicit image export.
useWhen: Text or a link needs a locally generated scannable graphic.

avoidWhen.condition: Scanning, session expiry or authentication is required.

composition: Compose Root, named Frame and Pattern; optional Overlay and DownloadTrigger remain under the same controller. RootProvider accepts useQrCode. Provide an ordinary link or text alternative.

rules.statement: Preserve compatible asChild hosts, scoped id/ids and React ref cleanup. Frame resolves to svg and Pattern to path. useQrCodeDownload supplies the QR producer to the existing download owner, not a second file-delivery lifecycle.
Preserve the accepted string; encoding does not validate, fetch or encrypt it. Do not expose secrets through generated labels or logging.
Keep the four-module quiet zone and verify actual decoding after changing size, colors, inversion or logos. ECC percentages do not guarantee safe logo coverage.
Use the QR DownloadTrigger for lazy snapshot export. Unsupported overlays require exportSrc or explicit includeOverlay=false. Handle onDownloadError; initiated is not saved.
Use result/error from the public controller; do not retain a stale code when encoding fails. Loading, expired and scanned status are application-owned.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using the QR as the only way to access content or assuming arbitrary HTML logos export.
commonMistakes.correction: Supply an accessible alternative and a supported image/SVG or explicit exportSrc.

validation: Verify exact decoding, SSR, controlled refusal, errors, refs, all encoding options, independent exports, CORS and cancellation.
